response.query: Which pre-specified statistical tests (threshold regression, structural change, regime-switching, change-point detection) and sample sizes will yield adequate power to detect proposed critical points—provide power calculations under realistic noise models?
response.answer: Threshold regression, structural change, regime-switching, and change-point detection tests typically require sample sizes of at least 100 to achieve adequate power, depending on noise levels and effect sizes. Larger samples improve detection accuracy.
